text:
We ain't nothin' but mammals
Well, some of us cannibals who cut other people open like cantaloupes

body: Despite the universal “we’re all mammals” sentiment, Slim Shady doesn’t want you to forget he’s the kind of psychopath who looks at human flesh the way you might look at the makings of a nice fruit salad.

The long “A” sounds in “mammals”, along with repeated first syllables in “cantaloupe” and “cannibal” reinforce the rhythm of these bars.  Since the realease of “The Real Slim Shady,” the unlikely pairing of “cantaloupe” and “cannibal” has been borrowed by a number of artists, including Earl Sweatshirt, JUNGLEPUSSY, Wakizashi, Mack Maine and Lord Infamous.
